contracts_rationale: No API or interface is defined: the mission edits doctrine pack content and graph files validated against the charter contract the charter repository owns.
friendly_name: Test doctrine 2: tests-as-scaffold paradigm, tracer bullets and measurement discipline
purpose_context: The first test-doctrine mission shipped the mock-boundary rule. This one finishes that work: the tests-as-scaffold mindset moves out of a binding directive into its own paradigm, the two mocking anti-patterns become named graph nodes, duplicated checklists and long worked examples move into shared reference assets, and the curator profile learns the canonical layout. It also sharpens test-first guidance with vertical tracer-bullet slicing (one behaviour, one failing test, one minimal change), ships a vertical-skeleton-first planning tactic for missions whose work crosses owners, separates refactoring from the red-green loop as a green-mode technique, and adds a measurement discipline so agents sharing a machine do not read killed or contended test runs as results.
purpose_tldr: Give the test doctrine its missing mindset, reference examples and checklists, and teach vertical tracer-bullet slicing and honest test measurement.
